Question 16

The line 2y−3x=−24 intercepts the x- and y-axes at points A and B, respectively. If the segment AB― is a diameter of a circle, find the equation of the circle.

a
(x−2)2+(y+3)2=213
b
(x−2)2+(y+3)2=13
c
(x−4)2+(y+6)2=52
d
(x−4)2+(y+6)2=13
e
(x−2)2+(y+3)2=52
